name: Erythrocercidae
description: Yellow Flycatchers are a small family of strikingly colored passerine birds endemic to sub-Saharan Africa. They are active insectivores that glean and hawk prey from foliage in forest and woodland habitats.

children.name: Erythrocercus
children.description: A genus of small, brightly colored flycatchers with rufous caps and yellow underparts.

children.name: Erythrocercus mccallii
children.description: The chestnut-capped flycatcher (Erythrocercus mccallii) is a species of bird in the family Erythrocercidae.

children.name: Erythrocercus livingstonei
children.description: Livingstone's flycatcher (Erythrocercus livingstonei) is a species of bird in the family Erythrocercidae. It is found in Malawi, Mozambique, Tanzania, Zambia, and Zimbabwe. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical dry forests and subtropical or tropical moist shrubland.

children.name: Erythrocercus holochlorus
children.description: The little yellow flycatcher (Erythrocercus holochlorus) is a species of bird in the family Erythrocercidae. It is found in Kenya, Somalia, and Tanzania. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forest and subtropical or tropical moist shrubland.
